# ez_fermat 解题思路
$m$ 是 flag 明文转换成的大整数  
$c$ 是密文  
使用 **RSA** 加密

$p$、$q$ 是大素数
$n = p \cdot q$  
$c = m^e \bmod n$  
$e = 65537$  
$a = (2025)_{16}$  
$b = (2026)_{16}$  
$h = (ap + b) ^ q$  
求解 $m$  

### 推导
$h \equiv b^q \pmod p$  
$n = pq = (p-1)q+q \equiv q \pmod{p-1}$
$\Rightarrow n = q + k(p-1) \ (k \in N)$
根据**费马小定理**有：  
$b^{p-1} \equiv 1 \pmod p$  
$\Rightarrow b^n = b^{q+(p-1)k} = b^q \cdot (b^{p-1})^k \equiv h \cdot 1^k \equiv h \pmod p$  
$\Rightarrow b^n = \pm kp + h \  (k \in N)$
$\Rightarrow |b^n - h| = kp$
$\Rightarrow p = \gcd(\set{kp, n})$
$\Rightarrow q = \frac n p$
$\Phi(n) = (p-1)(q-1)$
找到一个 $d$ 使得 $ed \equiv 1 \pmod{\Phi(n)}$
$m = c^d \bmod n$

### 解题代码
```python
n = 
c = 
hint = 
a, b = 0x2025, 0x2026
e = 65537

from Crypto.Util.number import *
from math import gcd

B = hint - pow(b, n, n)
p = gcd(B % n, n)
print(f'{p = }')
q = n // p
print(f'{q = }')
assert p*q == n
phi = (p-1) * (q-1)
d = pow(e, -1, phi)
print(long_to_bytes(pow(c, d, n)).decode())
# 输出：moectf{f3rmat_l1ttl3_th30r3m_l34ks_p_1n_2025}
```
